clarity.notes: Support and contradiction are compared directly; every ledger row opens source proof in context; exact deployed proof is one interaction away.

hierarchy.notes: The compact verdict strip yields to the evidence ledger and inspector. Graph complexity appears only for competing-claim topology.

typography.notes: Geist-like sans carries judgment while mono carries identity, receipts, state, and locators without tag soup.

motion.notes: Selection, filtering, collapse, and re-layout explain state change; mobile replaces spatial graph motion with an ordered path; reduced motion is supported.

brand.notes: The case ledger reads as a precision review instrument rather than an art-directed report or generic AI dashboard.

remaining_gaps: The dependency-free graph uses synthetic fixed positions; production edge routing and collision handling are outside prototype scope.
Mobile uses an ordered path instead of topology; owner review must confirm that this projection switch improves task time.
Only live owner review can validate observability and review efficiency; this score is not closure evidence.
